decisions.decision: Split synthetic frames across the two configured channels via each message's real assigned bus from the D-03 rate model (source.rates[i].bus -> logger_config.channels[j].name via matching .bus field), not an i%2 alternation.
decisions.rationale: More faithful to 'genuinely combined bus load' -- it is the same bus assignment the rate model itself used to hit config/gate.json's per-bus target_fps, unlike test_dual_bus_capture's simpler alternating split which was fine for a 2-message subset but would be arbitrary across the full 128-message DBC.

decisions.decision: [Rule 1 - Bug] Implemented the exact FanOutCounters conservation identity (frames_submitted == filtered + unknown_id + payload_too_long + unexpected_error + enqueued) instead of the plan's literal 'discard + enqueued + filtered == submitted' wording.
decisions.rationale: Traced through telemetry/capture/fanout.py's submit(): telemetry_enqueued increments on every successful deque.append(), INCLUDING appends that evict an older already-counted entry (deque(maxlen=N) drop-oldest); telemetry_discard_count is a subset flag on those same append events, not a disjoint bucket. Summing discard+enqueued+filtered therefore double-counts by telemetry_discard_count whenever it's nonzero, so the plan's literal equation only holds when discard==0 -- which contradicts critical constraint 5 (telemetry-path drops are EXPECTED, never asserted to zero). The identity actually implemented is exactly true by construction regardless of discard (every submitted frame falls into exactly one of those five FanOut.submit() outcomes). telemetry_discard_count is reported as a plain number (107 observed in the first passing run), never asserted to a specific value. Must be documented explicitly in 01-13-SUMMARY.md's Deviations section.

decisions.decision: achieved_fps wall-clock window spans from before the submission loop starts through archive_runner.join() returning (archive path fully drained), excluding writer.close()'s one-time MCAP footer-finalize cost.
decisions.rationale: close() is a fixed per-session cost, not part of repeating per-frame throughput -- including it would understate the sustained rate for a reason unrelated to the archive path's actual per-frame capacity.

decisions.decision: combined_target_fps is computed from config/gate.json's bus_targets (2900 + 830 = 3730.0), never a hardcoded literal like '~4000'.
decisions.rationale: Phase 0's own recorded lesson: prose figures drift from the config that actually produced them. The config is the single source of truth for the target.

decisions.decision: All per-stage timing instrumentation (submit, flush/sync, encode, framing, send) will live entirely in tests/test_soak.py, by wrapping bound methods and monkeypatching module-level functions -- no production module is touched.
decisions.rationale: This plan's files_modified is tests/test_soak.py only. Matches the existing repo convention already used in tests/test_archive_writer.py (writer._fsync = lambda fd: sync_calls.append(fd)) -- not a new pattern for this codebase.
